# Lab 4.9: Create Admin Roles & Delegate Administration

## What We Are Going to Do
Give Sam limited admin rights to reset passwords in one OU, instead of making him a Super Admin.

## Steps

1. **Create a custom admin role.** In the Admin console go to **Account → Admin roles → Create new role**. Name it `Engineering Helpdesk`.

2. **Choose privileges.** Under **Admin console privileges → Users**, tick **Read** and **Reset password**. Leave everything else unticked. Click **Create role**.

3. **Assign it to one OU only.** Open the role, click **Assign members**, add `sam@yourdomain`, and set the scope to the **Engineering** OU.

4. **Test it.** Sign in as Sam in a private browser window and open `admin.google.com`. Sam can only see users in **Engineering** and only reset their passwords.

5. **Check Super Admins.** Go to **Account → Admin roles → Super Admin → Admins**. Keep this list to two or three people.

6. **Review in the audit log.** Go to **Reporting → Audit and investigation → Admin log events** and filter for the role assignment.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Custom role | Only the privileges you tick |
| Scope | Limited to the Engineering OU |
| Super Admins | Kept to a very small number |
| Audit | Role changes appear in Admin log events |
